methodology.principle: Measure source contribution, not popularity. Metrics influence catalog maintenance and research effort, never automatic story ranking.

counters.items_seen: Relevant feed/search items inspected from this source.
counters.candidates: Items promoted into normalized story candidates.
counters.published: Stories where this source materially contributed to a published item.
counters.unique_discoveries: Published/shortlisted events first surfaced by this source before other catalog sources in the run.
counters.primary_confirmations: Material claims this source confirmed as authoritative primary evidence.
counters.independent_confirmations: Material claims this source independently corroborated.
counters.contrarian_hits: Useful credible evidence that materially complicated or falsified a dominant claim/narrative.
counters.builder_hits: Items that became a concrete Builder Radar action.
counters.research_hits: Items that became Research Digest or materially informed a concept/emerging signal.
counters.false_or_retracted: Items later found materially false, retracted or misleading.
counters.duplicate_only: Items adding no meaningful information beyond stronger/earlier sources.

notes: Every configured mandatory source class was checked for meaningful updates in the coverage window; mandatory status provided no ranking bonus.
Role-based discovery covered journalism, engineering, research, business/strategy, contrarian, builder, community and regional sources; broad open-web searches were run across configured categories.

The strongest continuity delta was not another restatement of frontier pacing: it was the collision between that proposal and new capital-market/geopolitical counterpressure, plus a production-effective DeepSeek API alias migration.

Primary DeepSeek documentation found in today's sweep partially closes the evidence gap recorded on Sep13; benchmark superiority remains a vendor claim because comparable independent end-to-end evidence is still insufficient.

Due three-day review for the internal agent-registry POC was completed and remained experimental. DeepSeek's Builder Radar item was upgraded to Trial specifically for migration/regression testing, not for benchmark endorsement.

No Research Digest was forced because no fresh paper cleared the practical/reproducibility threshold. No house eval was run because a fair DeepSeek before/after comparison requires pinned credentials and pre-migration fixtures unavailable to this automation.

promote_when: Repeated primary or independent verification value
Repeated builder/research/contrarian value in its assigned role
demote_or_reduce_cadence_when: Persistently high noise or duplicate-only rate
No meaningful contribution across a sufficient observation window
never_do: Do not rank a story higher because its source has a high historical score
Do not punish primary sources for low publication volume
Do not compare sources across incompatible roles without context
